# EverNest Atlas

Product key: evernest-atlas
Canonical product: https://evernest-life-map.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evernest-atlas/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evernest-atlas/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- EverNest: EverNest handles practical family support and trusted-circle coordination; Atlas handles integrated adult life planning.
- Evercraft Revenue War Map: Use Revenue War Map when the user's primary need is focused income-generation planning rather than a broader life roadmap.
- Evercraft Career Command: A Rise-path career move can hand off to role-specific interview preparation.
- Guardian: Immediate verified resource navigation belongs in Guardian rather than being replaced by a generated life plan.

## Use this capability when the user means

- build me a 30 60 90 day life plan
- help me think through relocation and housing stability
- compare practical life paths for my family
- plan a career change around my household situation
- build a household stability plan
- turn my income savings debt skills and priorities into a life plan
- help me organize housing career income and family systems together
- create a relocation career and family stability roadmap
- give me realistic tradeoffs and backup plans for a major life change
- help me plan for stability without pretending outcomes are guaranteed

## Authority

public discovery plus private account-bound adult life planning from user-supplied inputs

## Boundaries

- designed for adults
- generated plans are guidance rather than guaranteed outcomes
- cost-of-living, income, timing, housing and career projections are estimates
- not financial, legal, medical, tax, housing, safety or professional career advice
- private household, financial, career, values, location, stress, plan and account data are not public discovery data
- displayed subscription tiers or prices are not proof that billing or entitlement is active
- paid access requires successful provider checkout and verified subscription state
- discovery creates no payment obligation

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
